title: 第8214章 你来了第8213章 高飞出现
content_zh:
听到对方的问题，陆安没有拒绝回答。
“我就是。”
此人露出一丝笑容。
这笑容充满诡异，充满癫狂。
“我是高飞。”
陆安闻言，眉头微凝。
高飞？
他立刻想起来这个名字！
许氏兄妹对自己说过，在楚天殿中有一个怪人，三大怪人，也称为三怪，就叫高飞！
说这个怪人性格孤僻，阴晴不定，做事毫无规律，拥有三把强大的刀，还是个常年在黑星河中厮杀的黑手！
怪不得！
怪不得所有人在看到这个人到来时都噤若寒蝉，完全不敢说话。毕竟面对一个疯子，谁都担心自己的某一个动作会惹怒此人，招来杀身之祸。
而且高飞可不是乔万，乔万曾经被认为有顶级天赋，但一直没有兑现，结果很糟糕。但高飞不同。高飞同样拥有最顶级的天赋，以他的天赋，就算不加入楚天殿也轻松获得元令。而且他的天赋是兑现的，当时许氏兄妹给自己讲了很多关于高飞的事迹。说高飞曾经与院主动手，就连院主也无法占据上风。也就是说，高飞的实力已经达到院主的级别，属于天神境的巅峰，所以连黄宝道看到高飞也十分凝重。
高飞不是院主，是因为他不想当院主，也不适合当院主。
“看来你知道我。”高飞俯视陆安，声音同时带有锐利和沙哑。
“知道。”陆安承认，问道，“有事吗？”
陆安在想，难道对方也像乔万一样，来到这里只是为了嘲讽自己？
疯癫之人，与阴暗之人，应该不一样吧？
陆安并不知道对方的目的。
高飞看着陆安，发现这个年轻人面对自己竟然一丝一毫的惧怕都没有，倒是很意外。

而且这个年轻人不是初生牛犊不怕虎的张狂，不是因为狂妄才不惧怕，而是如此平静看着自己，明明知道他的身份，也并非事不关己，而是一种难以名状的平静。
这样的心境，让高飞十分意外，有一丝疑惑，但同时也升起一丝欣赏。
“我要看你的力量。”
高飞的话直截了当，语气不容置疑。
陆安看着对方，表情没有任何变化，开口，语气平淡。
“好处。”
高飞脸色一变。
庭院中所有人的脸色剧变，目瞪口呆！
陆安竟然与这个怪人谈好处？做交易？！
高飞的脸色也变得阴冷，冷笑问，“什么好处？”
“没有好处，我为什么要展示？”陆安反问。
“……”
“嘶……”
全场出现一片倒吸气的声音，所有人都无比紧张，甚至手脚都紧紧蜷缩！
高飞脸上的笑容不减，反而更浓。
“谁给你的元令？”高飞问。
content_en:
After hearing the other party's question, Lu An did not refuse to answer.
"I am."
The man smiled.
This smile is full of weirdness and madness.
"I'm Goofy."
Lu An frowned slightly when he heard this.
Goofy?
He immediately remembered the name!
The Xu brothers and sisters told themselves that there was a weirdo in the Chutian Palace, one of the three weirdos, also known as the Three Monsters, named Gao Fei!
It is said that this weirdo has a withdrawn personality, is unstable, does things irregularly, owns three powerful knives, and is a gangster who fights in the Black Galaxy all year round!
No wonder!
No wonder everyone was so silent when they saw this person coming, they didn't dare to speak at all. After all, when facing a madman, everyone is worried that one of his actions will anger the person and lead to death.
And Gao Fei is not Qiao Wan. Qiao Wan was once considered to have top talent, but it never materialized, and the results were terrible. But Goofy is different. Gao Fei also has the best talent. With his talent, he can easily obtain Yuan Ling even if he doesn't join Chutian Palace. And his talent was realized. At that time, the Xu brothers and sisters told themselves many stories about Gao Fei. It is said that Gao Fei once started a fight with the hospital owner, and even the hospital owner could not gain the upper hand. In other words, Gao Fei's strength has reached the level of the hospital master, which belongs to the peak of the gods, so even Huang Baodao was very solemn when he saw Gao Fei.
Gao Fei is not the dean because he does not want to be the dean and is not suitable to be the dean.
"It seems you know me." Gao Fei looked down at Lu An, his voice was sharp and hoarse at the same time.
"I know." Lu An admitted and asked, "Is something wrong?"
Lu An was wondering, could the other party be like Qiao Wan and come here just to mock him?
Crazy people should be different from dark people, right?
Lu An didn't know the other party's purpose.
Gao Fei looked at Lu An and was surprised to find that this young man didn't have the slightest fear when facing him.
Moreover, this young man is not arrogant like a newborn calf who is not afraid of tigers. It is not that he is not afraid because of his arrogance. Instead, he looks at himself so calmly. He clearly knows his identity. It is not that it has nothing to do with him, but an indescribable calmness.
Such a state of mind made Gao Fei very surprised and a little confused, but at the same time he also felt a sense of appreciation.
"I want to see your strength."
Gao Fei's words were straightforward and his tone left no room for doubt.
Lu An looked at the other person, his expression unchanged, and spoke in a calm tone.
"Benefits."
Gao Fei's expression changed.
The expressions of everyone in the courtyard changed drastically and they were stunned!
Lu An actually negotiated benefits with this weirdo? Make a deal? !
Gao Fei's face also turned cold, and he asked with a sneer, "What's the benefit?"
"There is no benefit, why should I show it?" Lu An asked.
"..."
"Hiss..."
There was a gasp in the audience, everyone was extremely nervous, and even their hands and feet were curled up tightly!
The smile on Gao Fei's face did not diminish, but grew stronger.
"Who gave you the Yuan Ling?" Gao Fei asked.
